package.description: Voice dictation and meeting transcription for Windows. Talk and your words appear at your cursor.

en-US.description: Voice dictation and meeting transcription for Windows. Talk and your words appear at your cursor.
en-US.longDescription:
TalkToType (formerly WinTranscribe) turns speech into text anywhere on
Windows. Hold a key, talk, release: the text lands at your cursor in any
app. Record meetings with microphone and system audio, get a live
transcript while you record, upload existing audio files, and generate
AI summaries with decisions and action items. Premium transcription keeps
speakers consistent across a whole recording. Custom dictionary and
multi-language support (Dutch, English, German, French, Spanish).
en-US.name: TalkToType
